title: Day 1 · The New Arrival
caption:
Through the glass doors and into the morning light. The grey Cole set under a black Brooks puffer, and the Fiona suit in wild mushroom with black heels.

CARBON presents The Art of Arriving, and the Autumn / Winter 2026 collection starts on this step. He wears the zip-up and joggers with the glossy quilted puffer open at the high collar, a black tee underneath and black and white sneakers. She wears the single-button blazer over a white ribbed top with a strappy neckline. Her pressed trousers fall straight to pointed heels.

Two ways through the same door, side by side.

Every Entrance Makes a Statement.

Shop the Winter Collection, link in bio.

title: Day 2 · Monochrome Navy
caption:
Navy on navy. The Romeo turtleneck with tailored Colin trousers and white sneakers, worn against warm stone and olive trees in the late afternoon sun.

Swipe through the pieces one at a time. The Romeo has a ribbed roll neck, ribbed cuffs and a ribbed hem on a close, textured knit. The Colin trousers run slim through the leg, with a buttoned waistband and belt loops. A silver chain hangs from the waist to the front pocket. The white sneakers finish it low, with a black side stripe and a black heel tab.

Hands in pockets and one shoulder against the stone, in a single shade of navy from the collar to the ankle.

title: Day 3 · The Denim Girl
caption:
Two blues, one jacket. The light-wash Jolie denim jacket over a brown Amelia bodysuit, with dark Nora flare jeans.

The pale denim sits up top and the deep wash runs long to the floor. The brown bodysuit holds the middle between them. Denim on denim, worn for the season's first cool evenings.

Shop the Winter Collection, link in bio.

title: Day 4 · Teal Track
caption:
Teal after sunset. The Gordon hoodie and joggers in teal with white CARBON Sneakers, up on a rooftop deck as the city lights come on.

Swipe from the stand to the jump to the shoes. A fine vertical rib runs through the whole set, with a drawstring hood, a front pocket, dropped shoulders and ribbed cuffs. The joggers taper to a cuffed ankle. In the second frame the set moves on its own, sleeves flung wide and one knee up. Then down to the wet concrete, where the white low-tops with a black side stripe catch the last of the light.

One colour from hood to hem, with clean white shoes to finish it.

Shop the Winter Collection, link in bio.

title: Day 5 · Tailored in Jade
caption:
Jade green, worn sharp. The Ride blazer, cropped at the waist with strong shoulders, over the black Celine Sweater and black Camille pleated trousers.

Swipe through the courtyard piece by piece. The blazer hangs open from a notch lapel, with the sleeves pushed up to the forearm. The Celine Sweater has a ribbed roll neck and a frayed hem that tucks away under the waistband. The Camille trousers sit high, with a single button, front pleats and a pressed crease down a wide leg. Black pointed-toe heels finish the line.

One bright layer over black, from the olive trees to the door.

Shop the Winter Collection, link in bio.

title: Day 6 · The Heels
caption:
Three black heels set out on sunlit marble steps. The Diamond, the Rock and the Classic heels give you one pair for each kind of entrance.

Swipe through them pair by pair. The Diamond is a peep-toe ankle boot covered in black crystals, with a zigzag edge around the top and a slim stiletto heel. The Rock is an ankle-strap sandal with a pointed square toe, a row of clear stones set in gold across the front, a gold buckle and a gold footbed that catches the morning light. The Classic is the plain black pump with a pointed toe and a high stiletto heel. Reach for it when the night has a dress code.

Shop the Winter Collection, link in bio.

title: Day 7 · Evening in the City
caption:
Golden yellow at blue hour. The Sirena maxi dress with sparkly Diamond heels, worn for the moment the evening turns cool.

This reel follows the dress as it moves. The warm yellow holds its own against the blue of the sky, and the long line of the maxi falls to the heels, where the sparkle picks up what light is left. It is a single piece that makes the whole look.

Shop the Winter Collection, link in bio.

title: Day 8 · Black and White, Underground
caption:
Black and white, underground. A white Miles knit with black Colin tailored trousers and CARBON Sneakers, standing on the platform beside the waiting train.

The knit has a nubby, textured face, a ribbed crew neck and dropped shoulders, with deep ribbed cuffs and a hem that sits right at the waistband. The Colin trousers run slim with a pressed crease down each leg and finish just above the ankle. Below them, the CARBON Sneakers are white low-tops with black panels and black laces. They pick up both colours of the look.

Arrive Different.

Shop the Winter Collection, link in bio.

title: Day 9 · Pink Knit, Blue Denim
caption:
Pink knit, light denim. The Brooke sweater worn loose over Anaya jeans, with white Queen sneakers.

Swipe and the look comes apart one piece at a time. The Brooke hangs long past the hip with dropped shoulders, a cut-out at the collar and open slits at both elbows, finished with ribbed cuffs and hem. The Anaya jeans sit high at the waist and run straight to a cropped ankle in a light wash. Last come the Queen sneakers, white low-tops with perforated sides and a thick sole. They wait on the sunlit pavement.

A bright knit for a sunny walk past the glass.

Shop the Winter Collection, link in bio.

title: Day 10 · The New Menswear Trio
caption:
Three looks on a grey rooftop. A stone Romeo turtleneck, the Untimely long-sleeve graphic in white, and the No Risk set in black.

In the middle, the Romeo's roll neck sits high and close, worn with mid-blue skinny jeans ripped at both knees and black-and-white low-top sneakers. Leaning on the wall, the Untimely long-sleeve carries painted lettering, a red mushroom, an orange blossom and a grinning face down the front, with dark indigo slim jeans. On the right, the No Risk set. The black hoodie reads NO RISK NO STORY across the chest and has a reminder on the pocket about later turning into never, with matching drawstring joggers and black sneakers on striped soles.

Built Different. Made For Everyone.

title: Day 11 · Dinner Reservation
caption:
Dinner at eight. The Daria dress in black, with one cut-out shoulder, and the jewelled Rock heels.

Golden-hour light on the stone, and the brass doors open behind her. The dress sits high at the neck with short sleeves and a teardrop opening at one shoulder, then runs close from the waist seam to mid-thigh. The Rock heels have a pointed toe, a fine ankle strap and a row of crystals across the front.

Shop the Winter Collection, link in bio.

title: Day 12 · Blue Hour Bomber
caption:
Blue hour. The Ellis bomber in black, worn open over a cream Amelia bodysuit, with Kira jeans and black ankle-strap heels.

The bomber stays clean with a ribbed collar, a silver zip and banded cuffs. Her hands are tucked into the pockets. Underneath, the Amelia is finely ribbed with a soft V-neck and a curved seam across the front. The Kira jeans sit high in a mid-blue wash, with a four-button fly and raw, frayed hems that stop just above the ankle. Warm light spills from the glass behind her while the water at her feet holds the last of the sky.

Shop the Winter Collection, link in bio.

title: Day 13 · The New Weekend
caption:
Weekend mode, golden hour on the terrace. A white Rhea jacket, cropped and cinched at the waist with a rope drawstring, over a ribbed blue Goldie top with a cut-out at the neck and light-wash Cassidy jeans, straight and cropped at the ankle.

Beside her, a beige Sean knit with a crew neck and worn-through holes down the sleeves, loose over slim mid-blue Finn jeans ripped at the knee. Blush trainers on her and black and white low-tops on him, hands in pockets for the slow walk past the columns with the sea behind.

Shop the Winter Collection, link in bio.

title: Day 14 · The Street Edit
caption:
Golden hour, top floor. The Dennis leather jacket in black with tan and rust chevron stripes, worn open over the black Street shirt and stone Harvey cargos.

The ribbed collar and cuffs finish the bomber shape, and the stripes pick up the last of the sun across the chest. The sun graphic on the Street shirt sits right in the open zip. Down low, the Harvey cargos carry flap pockets on both legs and a zip running into gathered ankle cuffs that land on black and white low-top sneakers.

Shop the Winter Collection, link in bio.

title: Day 15 · The Courtyard Conversation
caption:
Gold stripes and wild mushroom, out for the afternoon. The Cadence dress in black and gold walks beside the Furry set.

The Cadence is a halter mini with a deep V, gold bands around the waist and gold lines that curve down over the hips, worn with black pointed heels. The Furry set comes in wild mushroom, an oversized hoodie with a fluffy trimmed hood, a front pocket and a black drawstring at the hem, over cuffed joggers and white sneakers.

Two ways to cross the same sunlit courtyard, one dressed for the evening and one for the long afternoon.
